q: How is Scope 3 intensity per rupee of turnover reported in BRSR?
title: BRSR Scope 3 intensity per rupee
short: Divide total Scope 3 emissions, in tonnes of CO2e, by total turnover in rupees for the same year. It sits in Principle 6 leadership indicator 2, which also asks for a gas break-up if available, an optional intensity metric you choose, both years, and whether an external agency assessed the figure.
audience: Listed companies preparing BRSR, and suppliers whose data feeds it

ul: Total Scope 3 emissions, metric tonnes of CO2e, with a break-up into CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6 and NF3 if available.
Total Scope 3 emissions per rupee of turnover.
Total Scope 3 emission intensity, optional, on a metric the entity picks.
A note: was it independently assessed, evaluated or assured by an external agency, and if so, which one.

sections.h: What SEBI says about the arithmetic
p: SEBI's guidance note defines it as total Scope 3 emissions divided by total turnover in rupees. For other metrics it suggests units of product, production volume, floor area or full-time employees. It asks you to exclude GHG trades, apply GWP values and factors consistently, and disclose their sources.
Unlike the Scope 1 and 2 table, the Scope 3 table has no PPP-adjusted line. It is a leadership indicator, so it is voluntary.
Per rupee gives a tiny number, and a misplaced zero is the most common error. Give the figure per rupee as asked, and write the same value per crore of turnover beside it so a reader can check it.

sections.h: What the table does not ask
p: There is no line for categories. Name the Scope 3 categories you included and excluded in a note; the GHG Protocol Scope 3 Standard requires that list, with reasons for each exclusion.

example.title: Worked example: Rs 1,200 crore turnover
lines: Scope 3: purchased goods 21,000 t + upstream freight 3,000 t + travel and commuting 1,000 t = 25,000 t CO2e
Per rupee: 25,000 / 12,00,00,00,000 = 0.00000208 t CO2e, which is 2.08 g CO2e per rupee
Optional metric: 25,000 t / 50,000 t of product = 0.5 t CO2e per tonne

senseible: Senseible keeps purchase, freight and other Scope 3 lines in a separate supplier evidence trail with the document behind each. Its BRSR output is a self-declared draft, so the external agency note stays No unless an independent body checked the figure.
